Dear <<insert name>>, Dear Ms. Farraday,
I am writing at the request of my patient Mr. Ren scratch that Mr. Wren who was seen in our emergency department on Wednesday, March 23 for an acute viral sinusitis. He is a 27 year old man who works in your warehouse as a forklift operator and he presented with facial pressure, nasal congestion and a low grade fever since the evening before. After examination I started him on amoxicillin clavulanate for presumed secondary bacterial infection, because of persistent fever and worsening pain, new paragraph.
In my medical opinion Mr. Wren should be excused from work from March 23 through March 25 and may return on Monday, March 28 if the fever has resolved. Please note that he is not to operate heavy equipment untill he is no longer taking the sedating decongestant he was given. Since his wife Tamsin just delivered their son Abel, he has asked that I mention he will need to be home for help, I have advised him to speak with you about family leave, it is his decision.
This letter contains only what is necessary for the purpose of his absence, and no other medical information is being released. If you need anything further please send a signed release to my office. I can be reached through the department at the number above, or through Dana Whitcombe at ext. 4416.
Sincerely,
Kwame Osei MD (speech recog: "Quamme Ozzy") Kwame Osei, MD Attending Physician, Emergency Medicine
